name_ar: الياء الزائدة المثبتة وصلا المحذوفة وقفا
definition: A zaida ya is pronounced when joined and dropped when stopped, in 18 words (19 places): ومن اتبعن، يوم يأتِ، لئن أخرتن، المهتد (twice), يهدين، ترن، يؤتين، تعلمن، نبغ، تتبعن، أتمدونن، الجوار، المناد، اتبعون، الداع (al-Qamar 8), يسر، أكرمن، أهانن. The corpus writes the kept ya as a small yeh on the last letter.
limitations: Only the longer book Nabhan is cited; Book A does not have this topic.
Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
A closed list in the Kufian numbering used by the book; each word was checked in the corpus.
The note is the same for every reading context: the ya is pronounced when joined and dropped when stopped.
